name: hybrid-two-day-complex-prescriptions
source: GitHub issue #40 - five legible coaching screenshots captured July 21-22, 2026. This exact class previously exhausted the durable semantic validator and produced a terminal failure.

sketch.title: July 21-22, 2026
notes: Intent: Establish strength and capacity baselines for the block.
Primary Goal: Test current wall ball output; build max-effort strength in push press and deadlift.
Secondary Goal: Develop strength-endurance through ski erg, front squat, sled push, and wall ball combination work.
Intended Stimulus: Heavy, low-rep strength loading (3-4 RPE building to 7 RPE) followed by higher-rep muscular endurance work; mixed intensity session.

items.name: Wall Balls
items.note: Wall Ball Test: 1 min max effort @ race weight

items.name: Push Press
items.note: 2 x 10-15 primer sets @ 3-4 RPE, then 2 x 10 @ 6 RPE and 2 x 8 @ 7 RPE

items.name: Deadlift
items.note: 2 x 10-15 primer sets @ 3-4 RPE, then 2 x 10 @ 6 RPE and 2 x 8 @ 7 RPE

items.name: Wall Balls
items.note: 10 min EMOM at 60% of the test number; if the test was 30 reps, use 18 reps @ race weight. Record reps and whether all 10 sets were unbroken. Progression is based on hitting unbroken reps at the target number.

blocks.name: July 21 - Strength Endurance
notes: 4 rounds; rest 60 secs after each round

blocks.name: July 22 - AM: Aerobic Capacity Day
notes: 3 rounds; each round: 8 sets of 20 sec race-pace row / 60 secs very easy ski; after the 8th set, 6 dual DB devils press
Intent: Accumulate volume without accruing significant fatigue. Add a short conditioning stimulus without compromising recovery.
Primary Goal: Build sub-threshold aerobic durability through controlled tempo efforts. Build power-endurance through devils press.
Secondary Goal: Teach pacing discipline and staying below threshold even when capable of more. Light additional volume on an otherwise aerobic-focused day.
Intended Stimulus: Moderate, controlled intensity; athlete should finish feeling fully in control, not laboured. Short, moderate-intensity strength-conditioning hybrid; low overall systemic load.
